sections.Profile:
"Rescue 911," released by Gottlieb in May 1994, is based on the TV show of the same name. Designed by Bill Parker, it features three flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. The game includes a helicopter toy that picks up the ball, adding a unique interactive element. With artwork by Constantino Mitchell, David Moore, and Jeanine Mitchell, it captures the essence of emergency rescue missions.
